title: Why Honey Can Last for Years 🍯 #Shorts
script: Honey can stay edible for an incredibly long time when it is sealed properly. Its low water content and natural acidity make it difficult for many microbes to grow. Bees also add enzymes that help create an unfriendly environment for bacteria. That does not mean every jar lasts forever after contamination, but properly stored honey is remarkably stable. Follow for more surprising science facts.

scenes.sub: Microbes need available water to grow.
